bootstrap.statistics: mean and median of the household values, against zero, the value under independence

cases.channel_order: each silent channel is added in the declared channel order to show the cumulative confidence
cases.rule: for each household and quiet state, the maximal runs of consecutive windows that are fully silent and labelled with that state, at least 12 windows long; the case is the run of median length (the lower median, the earliest among equal lengths); its first 12 windows are recorded

criteria.correlation: 0.1, the conventional smallest correlation of note
criteria.log_ratio: log 1.25: at an inflation of 1.25, a posterior of 0.95 reached on silence alone would be 0.91 with the evidence corrected, which leaves the 0.95 to 1.00 confidence band of the uncertainty study
criteria.roadmap: ROADMAP.md is updated only if the conclusion is supported or weakened
criteria.slope: 0.02 per silent channel or per hour, the calibration-error minimal difference of Phases 3.1 and 3.2
criteria.supported: D1 and C1 are both positive: independence materially inflates silence evidence, and overconfidence grows with the number of silent channels
criteria.verdicts: positive: mean >= delta and lower bound > 0; negative: mean <= -delta and upper bound < 0; negligible: the whole interval within (-delta, delta); uncertain: anything else
criteria.weakened: D1 or C1 is negligible or negative
criteria.why_inflation: a constant excess of joint silence in every state shifts every state's evidence equally and cannot move a posterior; only its variation across states can, which is what D1 measures

definitions.accumulation_slope: the same for the gap on the position in a run of consecutive fully silent windows, in hours, over labelled fully silent windows at positions up to the declared limit
definitions.association: Spearman correlation across households of log_inflation and gap_slope, with a household bootstrap interval
definitions.count_correlation: Pearson correlation of the two channels' counts; undefined where either count is constant
definitions.count_covariance: covariance of the two channels' counts, divided by the number of windows
definitions.gap: confidence (largest posterior probability) minus 1 if its state is the annotated state, else 0
definitions.gap_slope: least-squares slope of the gap on the number of silent channels, after removing each predicted state's mean from both, over every labelled window; zero in expectation for a calibrated model
definitions.joint_silence: the same, for windows in which every instrumented channel is silent
definitions.log_dispersion: variance of the number of silent channels over the sum of p(1 - p) over channels, p unsmoothed; undefined where either is zero
definitions.log_inflation: log of SD_s[sum_c log p_c(s)] / SD_s[log p_joint(s)] over the household's eligible states whose joint silence is estimable, population SDs
definitions.log_inflation_declared: the same with sum_c of the filter's declared silence log-likelihood in place of sum_c log p_c(s)
definitions.log_odds_silence: log((n00 + 0.5)(n11 + 0.5) / ((n01 + 0.5)(n10 + 0.5))) over the pair's silent (0) and active (1) windows
definitions.pair_silence: the same, for windows in which both channels of a pair are silent
definitions.quiet: the mean over the household's eligible quiet states
definitions.silence_probability: (silent windows + a) / (windows + 2a), a = the declared smoothing
definitions.silent: a channel is silent in a window when it records no activation

estimands.question: how much independence overstates the spread of joint-silence log-evidence across states, with the channels' observed silence probabilities: dependence alone
how much more often every channel is silent than independence implies, in the quiet states
how much overconfidence grows per additional silent channel, within a state
how much the filter's declared silence terms overstate the spread of joint-silence log-evidence across states
how much of S1 comes from the declared rates rather than dependence: S1 minus D1
the median pairwise log odds ratio of silence, in the quiet states
the mean pairwise correlation of counts, in the quiet states
the variance of the number of silent channels against independence, in the quiet states
how much confidence grows per additional silent channel, within a state
how much accuracy grows per additional silent channel, within a state
how much overconfidence grows per hour of consecutive fully silent windows, within a state

households.use: every development household once; nothing is fitted, so the folds are not used

inference: unchanged: the diagnostic reads the filter's own emission terms and transition, and changes neither

min_expected.rule: a joint-silence statistic is computed only where at least this many windows would be jointly silent if the channels fell silent independently; a log odds ratio needs every cell of its table to reach it; the classical expected-count rule for contingency tables

model.emissions: default_emissions of the household registry, pooled per channel
model.fitted: nothing: every parameter is the declared default
model.model: the generative filter's model fed every window of the recording
model.prediction: most probable state of the posterior; no abstention
model.prior: stationary distribution of the default ontology, one step before each recording's first window
model.transition: default StateOntology, time-homogeneous, one step per window
model.windows: every step window from each recording's first observation to its last, in order, each channel's pooled count

name: phase3-correlated-silence
per_pair: log odds ratio of silence and log pair silence ratio per channel pair, each the mean over the household's eligible quiet states where it is estimable

per_state.count_correlation: mean over channel pairs of the correlation of counts
per_state.joint_silence_difference: observed joint silence minus the product of the channels' observed silence probabilities
per_state.log_dispersion: log of the variance of the number of silent channels over its variance under independence
per_state.log_joint_silence: log of observed joint silence over the product of the channels' observed silence probabilities
per_state.log_joint_silence_declared: log of observed joint silence over the filter's declared rates
per_state.log_joint_silence_poisson: log of observed joint silence over independent Poisson streams with each channel's observed mean count
per_state.log_odds_silence: median over channel pairs of the log odds ratio of silence
per_state.log_pair_silence: median over channel pairs of the log ratio of joint to independent silence

states.eligibility: a state enters a household's statistics with at least 50 labelled windows there

streams.definition: each instrumented evidence channel's activations in each step window; uninstrumented channels are left out

tuning: none: every setting is declared here, before any household is examined
